description: If \(M\) is finite and nonempty, some finite subset of its proper-extension theory is already unsatisfiable.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Diagrams.finite_obstruction_fragment.{u, v, w} {L : FirstOrder.Language} {M : Type w}
  [L.Structure M] [Finite M] [Nonempty M] :
  ∃ Γ,
    ↑Γ ⊆ Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Diagrams.properExtensionTheory L M ∧ ¬FirstOrder.Language.Theory.IsSatisfiable ↑Γ
